digest.component_or_area: rebar LLM provider factory / runner config validation
propositions: _pai_check_config currently raises on any base_url/api_key even though docs and config parsing already support them, making the documentation false.

An openai provider builder should honor REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL by constructing OpenAIChatModel with OpenAIProvider, while provider selection still comes from the model string / REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER, not from base_url.

For an arbitrary OpenAI-compatible endpoint the builder must withdraw only supports_json_schema_output (via a Provider subclass overriding model_profile) so it resolves to PromptedOutput instead of native strict output, keeping other capabilities intact.
The openai builder must be registered only when base_url is set so a bare openai:gpt-4o keeps S1's lazy model-string path and the openai SDK stays an optional runtime dependency.
_pai_check_config should validate instead of refuse: reject api_key without base_url, reject non-absolute base_url, and send a placeholder key for no-auth local servers.
A non-loopback ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL already routes through an Anthropic-wire gateway by accident and should be made deliberate and tested.
